question: Что такое HTTP methods и как это работает?
short_answer: HTTP methods express intent: GET reads, POST submits/creates/actions, PUT replaces at a known target, PATCH partially changes and DELETE removes.
junior_answer: HTTP methods express intent: GET reads, POST submits/creates/actions, PUT replaces at a known target, PATCH partially changes and DELETE removes. Safety means no requested state change; idempotency means repeating the same request has the same intended effect. These are semantics, not automatic framework enforcement. Важное ограничение: POST can be made retry-safe with an idempotency key, while a badly designed PUT can still have extra side effects.
follow_up_question: Какая типичная ошибка связана с HTTP methods?
follow_up_answer: Choosing a method only by whether it has a body ignores caching, retries and client expectations.
